cards.title: Documentation of Modeling Parameters and Assumptions
cards.claim: All system-specific and drug-specific parameters must be clearly specified with their sources and justifications. Key model assumptions impacting application, including biological rationales and mathematical representations, must be explicitly stated. Procedures for assessing uncertainty (e.g., sensitivity analysis) must be provided.
conditions: Required for regulatory or scientific qualification of the simulation model.
Applies to both library models and custom-built models.
required_inputs: Table of parameters with values, units, and sources.
limitations: Does not validate the scientific correctness of the parameters, only their documentation.
Library model modifications must be explicitly justified.
cards.downstream_use: Ensures traceability and reproducibility of the human simulation scenario.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
